displayName: Don’t install Microsoft Teams with new installations or updates of Office
description:
This policy setting allows you to control whether Microsoft Teams is installed with a new installation of Office or when an existing installation of Office is updated.

Note: This policy setting only applies to versions of Office, such as Office 365 ProPlus, where Teams is installed with a new installation or an update of Office.

If you enable this policy setting, Teams won’t be installed with a new installation or an update of Office.

If you disable or don’t configure this policy setting, Teams will be installed as part of a new installation or an update of Office, unless you have used some other method, such as the Office Deployment Tool, to exclude the installation of Teams.
